adaptation.aspects: Crop from the 1:1 master; never stretch. Keep the seven percent margin.
adaptation.type: Instrument Serif for display and monogram; Space Grotesk for captions, labels and body. No third family.
adaptation.photographs: One hero photograph at 2400 px on the long edge; supporting details at 1600 px.
adaptation.captions: At 390 px, caption text stays at 14 px or larger and never exceeds 18 words.

assets.grammar: Every element is a printed layer on one sheet of warm paper; nothing floats and nothing shines.

rigs.reason: No on-camera cast, no rig and no character construction.

sources.take: quiet margins and one photograph per page
sources.rights: public-domain family-album pages, observed only; no image reproduced

sources.notTake: digital gloss, foil or metallic sheen

sources.take: one slow page turn, held long enough to read
matte terracotta as the only accent

governance.review: The director reviews the card at 900 x 700 and on a 390 px phone, then signs.
questions: Should the page turn take 1.2 s or 1.6 s? The recorded choice is in governance.choices.

decisions.answer: 18 words maximum per caption, one or two full sentences.
decisions.reason: The frozen brief fixes 18 words and asks for dense captions.

decisions.answer: paper, ink, clay, linen, slate, umber. There is no metal role; slate is matte stone.
decisions.reason: The brief bans metallic sheen; the authoring guide says metal is a slot, not a material.

decisions.answer: A photograph counts as one colour in the four-colour cap.
decisions.reason: The brief sets a four-colour frame, so a photograph has to be counted.

decisions.answer: Only page_turn and hold. No cut, dissolve, iris, wipe or match cut.
decisions.reason: The brief asks for slow page turns and bans fast cuts; fewer transitions keep the style reusable.

decisions.answer: The title and close are type and rule only; the middle spreads carry the photographs.
decisions.reason: The brief says the first spread is the title, the last is a short close, and the six in between are photographs.

decisions.answer: No cleared image; the reference is described, not reproduced.
decisions.reason: No rights-cleared reference image is supplied in the sealed run.
The brief asks for one title spread, one caption-heavy spread and one close.

decisions.answer: Four reusable shot contracts carry the eight spreads.
decisions.reason: The style is a reusable system; the brief fixes one film, not eight bespoke layouts.

decisions.answer: CC0-1.0 control licence inherited from the sealed template.
decisions.reason: The pack is an internal control style and carries no third-party assets.
